rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: Edinho Silva won the PT's PED and 'will be the new national President'; the announcement was made at the party's headquarters in Brasília on the evening of Monday 7 July 2025. Of 342,294 votes counted by then for the presidency, 239,155 (73%) went to Edinho, then Rui Falcão 36,279 (11.15%), Romênio Pereira 36,009 (11.06%) and Valter Pomar 14,006 (4.30%).
